cases.name: CHK-001: story_list works
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.story_list(); return r && (typeof r === 'string' || typeof r === 'object')

cases.name: CHK-002: auto-bug no runner calls
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"auto-bug"}); const bad = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && (c.execute.includes("$handlers.test_auto(")||c.execute.includes("$handlers.test_story(")||c.execute.includes("$handlers.test_fixture("))); return bad.length === 0 ? "clean" : "violations:"+bad.length

cases.name: CHK-004: random bug IDs
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"tools-bug_list"}); const bc = f.cases.find(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report")); return bc && bc.execute.includes("Date.now()") ? "random" : "hardcoded"

cases.name: CHK-005: no chain links in fixture-uuid
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}); const linked = f.cases.filter(c => c.prevCaseId || c.nextCaseId); return linked.length === 0 ? "clean" : "linked:"+linked.length

cases.name: CHK-001-a0: story_get returns B-dd20 data
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.story_get({storyId:"B-dd20"}); return r !== null && r !== undefined

cases.name: CHK-003-h0: tools-bug_list has fixtureId
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"tools-bug_list"}); const br = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report(")); const missing = br.filter(c => !c.execute.includes("fixtureId")); return missing.length === 0 ? "all_have_fid" : "missing:"+missing.length

cases.name: CHK-003-h1: tools-bug_update has fixtureId
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"tools-bug_update"}); const br = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report(")); const missing = br.filter(c => !c.execute.includes("fixtureId")); return missing.length === 0 ? "all_have_fid" : "missing:"+missing.length

cases.name: CHK-003-e0: bug-case-binding setup has fixtureId
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"bug-case-binding"}); const setup = f.cases[0]; return setup.execute.includes("fixtureId") ? "has_fid" : "missing"

cases.name: CHK-003-e1: cli-gap-seal CHK-007 has fixtureId
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"cli-gap-seal"}); const chk7 = f.cases.filter(c => c.name && c.name.includes("CHK-007") && c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report(")); const ok = chk7.every(c => c.execute.includes("fixtureId")); return ok ? "all_fid" : "missing"

cases.name: CHK-003-a0: fixture-bug-binding intentional no-fid cases exist
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-bug-binding"}); const allCases = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report(")); return allCases.length > 0 ? "has_bug_report" : "none"

cases.name: CHK-003-a1: bug_report with fixtureId roundtrip
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"fid-rt-"+Date.now(),title:"fid roundtrip",description:"t",type:"chore",priority:"low"}); const sid = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const bid = "BUG-fid-"+Date.now(); const fid = "fid-"+Date.now(); $handlers.bug_report({storyId:sid,id:bid,title:"fid test",fixtureId:fid}); const bugs = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:sid}).bugs; const found = bugs.find(b=>b.id===bid); return found && found.fixtureId === fid ? "fid_match" : "mismatch"

cases.name: CHK-004-h1: bug-case-binding uses random IDs
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"bug-case-binding"}); const hardcoded = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && /"BUG-[A-Z][^"]*"/.test(c.execute) && !c.execute.includes("Date.now()")); return hardcoded.length === 0 ? "all_random" : "hardcoded:"+hardcoded.length

cases.name: CHK-004-e0: tools-bug_update uses $ctx.bugId
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"tools-bug_update"}); const br = f.cases.find(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("bug_report")); return br && br.execute.includes("$ctx.bugId") ? "uses_ctx" : "no_ctx"

cases.name: CHK-004-a0: all three target files have no hardcoded BUG IDs
cases.execute: const files = ["tools-bug_list","tools-bug_update","bug-case-binding"]; let violations = []; for(const name of files){ const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:name}); for(const c of f.cases){ if(c.execute && /"id":"BUG-[A-Z]/.test(c.execute) && !c.execute.includes("Date.now()")) violations.push(name); }} return violations.length === 0 ? "all_clean" : "violations:"+violations.join(",")

cases.name: CHK-004-a1: bug IDs have semantic prefix
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"bug-case-binding"}); const bugCalls = f.cases.filter(c => c.execute && c.execute.includes("BUG-")); return bugCalls.length > 0 ? "has_prefix" : "no_prefix"

cases.name: CHK-005-h1: fixture-chain no chains
cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-chain"}); const linked = f.cases.filter(c => c.prevCaseId || c.nextCaseId); return linked.length === 0 ? "clean" : "linked:"+linked.length

cases.execute: const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-bug-binding"}); const linked = f.cases.filter(c => c.prevCaseId || c.nextCaseId); return linked.length === 0 ? "clean" : "linked:"+linked.length

cases.name: CHK-005-a0: no one-sided chain refs in any cleaned file
cases.execute: const files = ["fixture-uuid","fixture-migrate","fixture-chain","fixture-bug-binding"]; let onesided = 0; for(const name of files){ const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:name}); for(const c of f.cases){ if((c.prevCaseId && !c.nextCaseId) || (!c.prevCaseId && c.nextCaseId)) onesided++; }} return onesided === 0 ? "no_onesided" : "found:"+onesided

cases.name: CHK-005-a1: no self-referencing chains
cases.execute: const files = ["fixture-uuid","fixture-migrate","fixture-chain","fixture-bug-binding"]; let selfref = 0; for(const name of files){ const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:name}); for(const c of f.cases){ if(c._id && (c.prevCaseId === c._id || c.nextCaseId === c._id)) selfref++; }} return selfref === 0 ? "no_selfref" : "found:"+selfref
